# Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership

> UC Berkeley's Fung Institute offers a one-year Master of Engineering degree combining technical depth across seven engineering disciplines with comprehensive leadership development and real-world capstone projects.

The Fung Institute at UC Berkeley prepares engineering leaders through an integrated curriculum that balances advanced technical coursework with professional leadership skills, industry mentorship, and hands-on capstone experiences. The program spans seven engineering departments and emphasizes practical problem-solving for real-world challenges.

## Key Topics

- Master of Engineering (MEng)
- Engineering Leadership
- Bioengineering
- Electrical Engineering & Computer Sciences (EECS)
- Mechanical Engineering
- Civil & Environmental Engineering
- Materials Science & Engineering
- Industrial Engineering & Operations Research (IEOR)
- Nuclear Engineering
- Leadership Development
- Capstone Projects
- Tech+PLUS Certificates
- Communications for Engineering Leaders (E295)
- Career Development
- UC Berkeley Engineering

## Master of Engineering Program

- [UC Berkeley Master of Engineering Program – 1 year degree](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program): Main MEng program page combining engineering management with technical depth
- [The Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu): Homepage for Fung Institute at UC Berkeley, defining engineering leadership education

## Engineering Departments & Specializations

- [Engineering Departments - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/engineering-departments): Overview of seven engineering departments for MEng program applications
- [Bioengineering - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/engineering-departments/bioe): UC Berkeley Bioengineering MEng program with engineering leadership focus
- [Electrical Engineering & Computer Sciences - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/engineering-departments/eecs): EECS MEng program with innovative scientific and technical courses
- [Mechanical Engineering - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/engineering-departments/me): ME MEng program covering robotics, biomaterials, and computational mechanics
- [Civil & Environmental Engineering - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/engineering-departments/cee): Civil & Environmental Engineering MEng program at Fung Institute
- [Materials Science & Engineering - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/engineering-departments/mse): MSE MEng program ranked top-two by US News for student training
- [Industrial Engineering & Operations Research - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/engineering-departments/ieor): IEOR MEng program combining business and applications-focused coursework
- [Nuclear Engineering - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/engineering-departments/ne): Nuclear Engineering MEng program addressing energy and health applications
- [Berkeley MEng Tech+PLUS Certificates - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/techplus): MEng certificate programs in materials, biomaterials, and nuclear specializations

## Leadership Development Curriculum

- [Leadership Development - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/leadership-development): Leadership development curriculum with industry veterans and innovators
- [Core Leadership Courses - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/leadership-development/core-leadership-courses): MEng curriculum covering business, leadership, technical courses, capstones
- [Communications for Engineering Leaders (E295) - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/leadership-development/capstone-integration-course): E295 course training persuasive writing and stakeholder engagement skills
- [Leadership Teaching Team - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/leadership-development/engineering-leadership-teaching-team): Faculty and industry professionals teaching MEng leadership curriculum
- [Affinity Groups - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/leadership-development/affinity-groups): Student affinity groups for biotech, design, sustainability, transportation
- [Fung-Sponsored Courses - Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/leadership-development/sponsored): Fung-sponsored leadership courses for undergraduates and PhD students

## Capstone Experience

- [Capstone Experience – Innovative solutions for the real world](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/capstone-experience): MEng capstone projects partnering with Berkeley faculty on real-world solutions
- [Berkeley MEng Capstone Project Format](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/capstone-experience/project-format): Capstone project structure emphasizing integrative, experiential team learning
- [Capstone Project Integration with Curriculum](https://funginstitute.berkeley.edu/programs-centers/full-time-program/capstone-experience/curriculum-integration): Capstone integration synthesizing expertise across domains for problem-solving
